correctness.rationale: The simplicial Alexander dual is characterized exactly: it is the 2-row (2,2)-capacity chessboard complex X_n plus n isolated diagonal 1-cells. Jojić--Vrećica--Živaljević arXiv:1412.0386 Theorem 4.4 applies to all n>=5, giving pure shellability, connectivity and torsion-free H3(X_n). Relative integral long exact sequence and combinatorial Alexander duality give H_{2n-6}=Z^{1+n(n-5)(n-3)(n-2)/4}, H_{2n-4}=Z^n, otherwise zero. Equivariant Alexander duality induces the correct ambient vertex-permutation sign. All conjugacy forms of fixed oriented simplices yield the stated signed traces for sigma and tau sigma, including transpositions and 4-cycles. Standalone exact finite checks over n=4..8 and 120+720 full permutations corroborate; infinite proof does not depend on enumeration.

value.rationale: Bayer et al. identify equivariant homology and shellability of graph cut complexes as main targets. Crown graphs form the canonical dense matching-deleted bipartite family with many overlapping 4-cycles, not encompassed by complete-bipartite or sparse-square results. The theorem classifies integral homology in two nonadjacent degrees for every n>=5, proves optimal connectivity and universal nonshellability, and explicitly determines the whole S_n x C2 rational character and the integral top lattice. The part-flip parity and dependence on 4-cycles are genuine structural symmetry data beyond the known chessboard homotopy.
